description: To deliver a paid origin tool, pass origin_tool with origin_arguments and idempotency_key; a call without origin_tool reads the receipt and does not consume a unit. Use this to read an already-paid resource, or to finish a payment that is still confirming. A call without origin_tool returns the receipt and does not consume a unit. Pass origin_tool and optional origin_arguments to run one paid origin tool. Only a successful origin result consumes one unit. A JSON-RPC error or isError result does not consume a unit. Pass the same idempotency_key to repeat a successful delivery without consuming another unit. The same key can be tried again after a failed delivery. Pass list_origin_tools true to list origin tools and their inputSchema without consuming a unit. Input: tx_hash, or offer_id, or intent_id. It never charges.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Repeating the same key returns the same origin result and does not consume another unit.

intent_id.description: Payment intent id, when you have one instead of a transaction hash.

list_origin_tools.description: Optional. When true and origin_tool is omitted, list origin tools and do not consume a unit.

offer_id.description: Offer id, to finish a payment that is still confirming or to redeem remaining units.

origin_arguments.description: Optional object of arguments for origin_tool. Values are not logged.

origin_tool.description: Optional. Run this paid origin tool and consume one unit. Omit it to read the receipt without consuming a unit.

tx_hash.description: Sepolia transaction hash from pay_and_access or from your own settled x402 payment.
